nodes.body: Impact: `sm-list.bb` parses the ledger by splitting on `(?m)^- ts:`; this entry matches no boundary, so it is silently absorbed into the preceding 2026-10-06 entry's chunk and is never listed as its own reflection. Any future `- ts:`-keyed consumption (the skill's own `sm-log.bb` template, spore-review tooling, human tailing by entry) has the same blind spot. Evidence: the mounted session-mycology skill defines the entry template starting with `- ts:` plus `p-efficiency:`/`p-friction:`/`p-skill-candidate:` fields; all ~40 existing entries in this file begin with `- ts:`; the new entry (lines 525-527) is the only one that does not, and it renames the score keys to prose (`efficiency 0.70; friction 0.62; skill-candidate 0.45`), omitting the field lines (`session`, `task`, `spore`, `receipt-refs`) the template calls for. Smallest corrective direction: rewrite the appended entry in the standard `- ts:` field format (the same content fits), keeping the append-only position.

Fixed in e838f2cc97f16e0815f1e7859d79a66f2c22e28a: actual upstream sm-log.bb appends a standard current reflection with task/session/three p-fields and provenance, and actual sm-list.bb --ledger-only --limit 1 now lists it separately. The original 30,344-byte reflection prefix stays exact; the new entry is 1,053 bytes. .ημ/verification/foresight24-mycology-correction-20261007/reader-writer-proof.json and lossless before/writer/after captures verify portable reader behavior. The original malformed prose remains immutable historical context, with no retroactive parsing repair or live event-schema claim. The complete review body is also addressed by independent-original-capture-proof.json: all eight original streams match their four size/SHA capture contracts and exact published blobs, and event history preserves the accepted-base prefix plus its 1,070-byte append. Actual immutable receipt consumer passes 202 forms/two new rows; all other inherited source/card/config/event identities remain unchanged. No new CI gate, historical runtime replay, approval or completed cohort is claimed.

Impact: every prior entry in this ledger (and the session-mycology skill template) uses the `- ts:` field format; sm-list.bb enumerates records by that boundary, so this new block never appears as a reflection of its own and pollutes the preceding entry's chunk with foreign prose, while the same Scores/note text exists twice in the file (lines 527 and 536). Evidence: full file read shows 525-527 as the only non-`- ts:` entry; the PR's own sm-list-before capture decodes to the heading absorbed after the 2026-10-06 note, sm-list-after decodes to only the structured record listed, and the native MiMo inline finding 4202326917 (embedded in this diff) independently identifies the same defect at this line. Smallest corrective direction: since the structured record at 528-536 already carries the content, drop the unparseable 525-527 block from the PR (the branch is unmerged, so no published history is rewritten) or, if append-only discipline forbids that, leave the disclosure as-is and accept the low-severity residue.
